notes.title: Moonstone Crossroads Update 6.5!
notes.content:
The first part of our biggest update is finally out! This is long overdue, we know. We're just glad to be back on a regular schedule after these crazy past few months. In this first part, we've added rain, part of the new sword system, fall damage, and new features for the truck! See details below:


Features


- Rain 
 (There will now be rainy days. The rain may last all day or come and go throughout some days )

- Sword System
 (There's a sword and training dummy in the side of your house now! Be sure to practice your form for the upcoming foes in part 2)

- Fall Damage
 (If it looks like it'll hurt you, it will. Hospital fees cost 1000 Gc)

- New Truck Features
 (Two new features for the truck. An added horn and windshield wipers for the rain)


Changes

- If anyone needs to know this, the power button for the truck has been move .15mm to the right.

- Hands now have animations depending on how hard you squeeze the trigger.


Fixes

-Fixed some internal issues. There may be more. If you see any, let us know :)

Thank you for your patience and support as always! Enjoy and look forward to part 2 of the update that will feature a new world to explore and new foes to face!

notes.title: Moonstone Crossroads Update 6!
notes.content:
A quality of life update focusing on features for more immersive gameplay. Details below:

Features


- Energy System
 (New energy system for use with certain weapons and future abilities)

- Food Eating
 (You can now eat certain edible items including crops and fruits by holding them in front of your mouth. Restores health and stamina)

- SmartWatch
 (A smartwatch that the player will carry from the start. Let's you see your health, stamina and tells time! Can be switched between arms)

- Bug Net
 (Let's you catch and collect items. There are now insects scattered around the world)

- Foliage
 (Added much more foliage to the world)

- Alarm Clock
 (You can now pass time by setting an alarm and sleeping right to it. It also restores health and stamina. It also tells time!)

- Calander
 (So you can count the days you've lived)



Changes

- The inventory system is completely revamped. All items are now accessible via one tab. Equipment can now be swapped by simply tossing them between hands.

- The binoculars has been replaced by the new spyglass. Give it a look-see.

- The Blunderbuss 419 is no longer. Has been replaced with the new Energy Blaster (pistol)

-  Re-done the graphical settings. You can now set more specific settings for optimized gameplay.

Fixes

- Various bug fixes (no one's counting)

notes.title: Moonstone Crossroads Update 4!
notes.content:
We're finally releasing our biggest update yet! It's been a long ride (pun intended), but we're excited for you to try the new features! See the details below:

Features

- Fully Drivable Pickup Truck
 (We've added a full tutorial on how to operate the vehicle)

- Present Box
 (Gives you stuff!)

- New Backpack Features
 (You can now set items of your choosing to be grabbed from your left or right shoulders)

- New Storage Chest
 (You can now organize and store items)

- New Outline System
 (Items you're trying to grab will have an outline indicator)



Changes

- Tablet is now an item you can equip via your inventory

- Shipping bin now reflects the new storage chest system

-  Slingshot minigame now charges 200Gc per play

- Slingshot minigame time increased to 50 seconds

- Teleportation costs Gc now


Fixes

- Various bug fixes (but who's counting?)

notes.title: Moonstone Crossroads Update 3
notes.content:
Hey! We're back with a new update highlighting new crops to grow! We've also made some more comfort options. Details are below:

Features

- New Crops
Apple trees, orange trees, cabbages, leeks, squash, carrots, turnips, and watermelons. 

- Weeds now grow on land
You'll have to pull the weeds off the land and they will regrow if a crop is not occupying the plot.

- Plants now die after 3 days without water

- Sprinting (double tap forward)

- For touchpad users: You now have the option to touch or press down to move.



Changes

- Farming system redone (performance enhancements)

- Crops are no longer uniform. They will grow in different directions/rotations.

- Changed prices for crops.

- Seeds are now found through your inventory.

- You can now throw the seeds. (Seeds are a physical mesh now)

- Watering can particle effect changed.

- Hoe and watering can performance tweaks.


Fixes

- Fixed the hole on top of the fir tree.

- Fixed an issue with music player when hitting play with no music in the music folder would stop the ambient music.

- Fixed an issue with the slingshot minigame where trying to play without enough Gc would cause an inability to play until a full restart of Moonstone Crossroads.

- Fixed an issue with the shipping bin paying multiple times for one item. (sorry folks, no more freebies)

IMPORTANT NOTE: For this update, it is recommended to delete your save data to avoid compatibility bugs. (We've made it easy to do via the game)

-Tablet overhaul

Fixes

- Fixed an issue regarding the shipping bin not paying the player after reloading save data (Sorry!)
- Fixed various frame rate issues
- Fixed slingshot minigame bell ringing

notes.title: Moonstone Crossroads Launch & Update 1
notes.content:
Hey Everyone! We are so excited to release our VR game: Moonstone Crossroads! We've already made changes from pre-release to today and the changelog goes as follows:

Features

- Saving is now possible at any time via the menu (see image)
- Disable/enable Lazuli option is now available (she won't take it personally) (see image)
- Organize items in your inventory
- Obtained items notifications 1.0 


Changes

- Tablet recalls the last freeze/unfreeze option player has used
- Shipping bin must be opened manually (no more annoying opening sound every time you walk past it)
- Changed the look of harvested fully grown potatoes


Fixes

- Various bug fixes (we're obligated to say that)
- Inventory tweaks
- Tweaks to the day/night system (new skysphere/new system)
- Ducks eat all food now :D

That's all for now, but bigger updates are coming within the month! Starting with music!
